entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return. Order number is 77-5-B-91.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me pull that up... I see an order for the VeloFit cycling shoes. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with them?
They don't fit. I've tried adjusting the cleats, everything. They just give me terrible blisters after every ride. I just want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for you. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see they were delivered to you 77 days ago.
Right. So can I return them or not?
Yes, absolutely. Our policy allows for returns on standard items up to 90 days after delivery, so you're well within that window. I can process this return for you right now.
Great. Finally. What do you need from me?

I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive it, we'll issue the full refund back to your original payment method.
Okay, got the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
